body:
**Reconciliation — the target bundle lineup is now ruled (executive-desk `decisions/0007`, 2026-07-14).**

0007 splits the old `project-workflow` plugin into two shipping bundles (Fork B): the **loop** (which *keeps the `project-workflow` name* — handoff, planning-desk, comms, github-project-board, board-triage) and a new **repo-standards** bundle (compliance-audit, mise-en-place, memory-taxonomy, repo-meta-structure, readme-value-and-proof, private-fork).

**Effect on this issue — the target is confirmed, lightly sharpened:**
- Both hooks attach to the **loop bundle** (`project-workflow`, which retains the name), as its nudge layer — not the repo-standards bundle. context-watermark (context management) and handoff-freshness-guard (handoff nudge) are both loop concerns, so the P4 "agent + hook per plugin" framing lands on the loop bundle.
- The deliverables and acceptance criteria are otherwise unchanged: promote-and-harden through the workbench gate, roster hook primitives with promotion-log records, machine-local originals retired, behavior-identical side-by-side.

Still **parked, rides the one-repo-rewrite** — 0007 fixes the marketplace target the rewrite builds toward, so the rewrite's work order can now carry this cleanly.

**Executive-desk re-triage ruling (Henry, 2026-07-16; enacting decision 0016 §6 "keep only what a use case still pulls"; recorded as desk decision 0017).**

**Closed — superseded by the candidate path.** The two named hooks (context-watermark, handoff-freshness) now ship in the foreman-kit candidate, which enters via the new distribution entry gate; the broader which-hooks-to-carry question is the ledger's deferred 10-hook evaluate-or-retire item (revisited when the hook set is next touched). The gate's machine floor already accepts the ratified hook-dir layout.
